text:
sam: Support escalation -> CS: Nebula Therapies trial ingestion failing intermittently. Support saw 429s then 504s during a large nightly seed. AE says they're demoing in 36h and account health flagged as at-risk. Need CS comms + immediate mitigation.

katie: Thanks. Any indication this is rate-limit or downstream model slow? Can you drop the last error lines? Need to know what to tell the customer. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

rowan: quick paste: `2024-08-01T23:41:12Z WARN rate_limiter: too many requests tenant=nebula tid=0x9f24` then later `2024-08-01T23:42:01Z ERROR proxy: upstream timeout from model-runner-7` So looks like burst + some runner degradation. No auth issues.

rowan: Ops mitigation suggestions: (A) apply a temporary tenant rate profile bump (increase qps) for the planned ingest window, (B) switch route to `embed-stable-v2` which has more capacity, or (C) ask customer to space batches and reduce concurrency. Command to bump qps: `infra tenant update-qps nebula --qps 1200 --note "trial ingest bump"`

miguel: If we bump qps, we should also watch memory on model-runner-7. I can set an autoscale trigger and keep a short window open. If we switch model route, some vectors may re-embed with slightly different embeddings; CS should warn the customer.

sam: Let's avoid changing model if possible to reduce mismatch for their demo. Plan: 1) temporary qps bump for tonight (owner: rowan/ops) 2) ask Nebula to throttle to 4 workers and batch_size 10 (owner: katie/CS) 3) AE notif + renewal-risk tag (owner: sam). Katie, can you send a short customer note?

katie: Drafting now (send in 5m): "Hi Nebula team — we're seeing intermittent throttling during large ingests. For tonight's seed, could you please reduce concurrent workers to 4 and batch_size to 10? We're enabling a temporary capacity bump on our side and will confirm when stable. Expect update in 20m." Add ETA?

sam: Add expected confirmation in 20m and potential rollback in 2 hours if regressions persist. Also say we won't reprocess older vectors yet to avoid inconsistency.

rowan: Ops: qps bump applied at 1745560050. Monitoring started. ops-bot: Action recorded as TASK-7891.

ops-bot: Autoscale policy provisional: enable scale-up at cpu>70% for model-runner-7, window=120s.

miguel: Monitoring: latency tail improved ~30%, rate of 504s reduced. Still seeing occasional 429 spikes at 1-2/min.

katie: Sent the customer message at 1745560150. Customer acknowledges and will throttle workers to 4 for the next 2 hours. They asked: will embeddings change if you bump capacity?

miguel: Bump won't change model weights; embeddings identical unless we switch model. Mention that to customer.

sam: Good — AE updated and tagged renewal-risk. CS note: create a follow-up touchpoint tomorrow post-demo and include a study of ingest pattern recommendations. Also request product/infra to consider pre-warm for large seed ingests.

rowan: 10m check @1745560750: error rate near zero, CPU on model-runner-7 trending down after scale. Keeping monitors for 3 hours.

katie: Thanks team. For the postmortem please include: timeline, customer impact severity, mitigation performed, recommended permanent fixes (ingest throttling guidelines, qps smoothing, pre-warm run in infra). I'll prepare customer-facing recap after the demo.

sam: Closing CS handoff for now. Owners: TASK-7891 (ops bump) -> rowan, AE follow-up -> sam, customer recap -> katie. Reopen if errors recur. :white_check_mark:
